notes.title: "Astral Quester" Playtest Version Unveiled – Dive into the Future of Gaming!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44767167/fa93bae9837c68bbb4a6baf691d98d4310105a31.png[/img]
Dear Astral Questers,


   The highly anticipated game, "Astral Quester," has officially launched its Playtest version, offering gamers an exclusive sneak peek into the exciting world of this innovative title.
Playtest Server:

The Playtest server is now live and serves as the testing ground for the game's upcoming features and content. This presents a unique opportunity for players to get a firsthand experience of what the future holds for "Astral Quester."
Invitation to Pioneers:

Enthusiasts who revel in pioneering versions are invited to join the Playtest. This is a chance to be among the first to explore and provide valuable feedback on the game's cutting-edge features.
Bug Reporting:

Players encountering any issues or bugs during the Playtest are encouraged to submit detailed bug reports to tech@wanosyo.com. The development team is eager to receive feedback and appreciates the community's assistance in refining the gaming experience.
Gratitude:

The development team extends heartfelt thanks to the gaming community for their support and enthusiasm. The Playtest marks a significant step forward, and the team looks forward to creating an unforgettable gaming experience with the help of player feedback.

Best Reguards,
Astral Dune Studio
